notes: Representative human-reviewed subset of EDPB Guidelines 01/2022 on data subject rights - right of access, consultation version 1.0 (18 January 2022) -> final adopted version (v2.x, after public consultation). The sampled changes were reviewed directly against the extracted text of both PDFs and correspond to documented post-consultation edits: removal of the consultation watermark, expanded completeness wording around providing a copy, a changed qualification of whether an exception affects confirmation of processing, and footnote/citation reflow. A bounded complete scope was source-reviewed on 2026-09-07; other expectations and the rest of the PDF remain partial.

changes.note: The consultation watermark no longer appears on every page of the final version.
